headline: Strong recovery off the $60 low — pressing into the $76-78 supply (4H 200-EMA / daily 50-EMA)
liquidity_note: ⚠ recovery into first major supply at $76-78 — clears it = trend extends, rejects = countertrend bounce

meta.market_state_note: Crash to $60 was reclaimed by a clean higher-high/higher-low recovery (~73% retraced) that has pushed back above the daily 20-EMA. Now meeting first real supply at $76-78 (4H 200-EMA + daily 50-EMA); daily stack still bearish, so the recovery is strong but unconfirmed.

pattern_candidates.name: Structure Shift
pattern_candidates.summary: The crash structure is broken — a higher-high/higher-low recovery has reclaimed the daily 20-EMA, but it still has to prove itself through the $76-78 supply before the shift is confirmed.

stop.note: Below the reclaimed $68-69 shelf — shift negated

evidence: A clean recovery off $60.03 (higher low $62.3, higher high $76.06) shows dips are being bought — the crash's lower-low rhythm is broken.
Price has reclaimed the daily 20-EMA ($72.33) and sits above the 4H 20/50-EMAs — short-term control has flipped up.
~73% of the crash is already retraced, a deep recovery that signals real demand rather than a dead-cat bounce.
CVD is rising hard into the move (genuine taker buying), though OI is falling — part of the push is short-covering, not fresh leveraged longs.
missing: No acceptance through the $76-78 supply (4H 200-EMA + daily 50-EMA) yet — that's the trigger that confirms the shift.
Daily stack still bearish (20<50<200) and OI declining, so conviction isn't fully there.

pattern_candidates.name: Bull Flag
pattern_candidates.qualifier: 4H — impulse to $76, shallow pause beneath it
pattern_candidates.summary: The push to $76 and the tight pause under it is a continuation flag forming, but it only becomes a trade on a clean break of the recovery high.
evidence: After the $67.4 → $76.06 thrust, price is holding gains in a tight pause — sellers can't claw it back, so breakout pressure is building.
The pause sits on the 4H 20-EMA ($70.93) reclaim and the $71-72 shelf — the breakout structure is intact.
CVD rising with price supports the continuation if it triggers.
missing: No break of $76.06 yet — the flag hasn't triggered, so it's a setup-in-waiting.
$76 is the 4H 200-EMA — the breakout has to overcome real overhead supply to run.

pattern_candidates.name: Resistance Retest
pattern_candidates.summary: The recovery is running into the 4H 200-EMA / daily 50-EMA — the first real ceiling — where a countertrend bounce typically stalls; it just hasn't rejected yet.
evidence: The bounce is arriving at $76-78 — the 4H 200-EMA ($75.79) and daily 50-EMA ($78) stacked together — the first heavy supply since the crash.
Daily stack is still bearish (20<50<200), so the dominant trend favours sellers at resistance.
OI falling through the recovery flags a short-covering rally that can run out of fuel into supply.
missing: No rejection / lower high confirmed yet — price isn't even at the zone (the trigger).
Rising CVD shows real buying that cuts against the fade — the main risk to this read.
